shortDescription: CarMax is betting some people will still want to shop for cars in person, rather than solely online. "In a Large Used-Car Market, CarMax and Carvana Clash Over How Americans Buy," at 12 p.m. ET, incorrectly said the company was betting that apps would become the primary way people buy cars.
